capabilities: Embed interactive 3D scenes in notes via code blocks
Open 3D files directly from the file explorer in a dedicated tab
Configure scene lighting, camera, background, and model transforms per embed or globally
Embed grids of multiple models in one block
Capture scene snapshots and write them as properties for Bases card view thumbnails
extras: README warns that WebGL renderer limits cap active scenes at 16 (8 on mobile) and that large models can lag the whole vault; a GUI for scene editing is marked BETA; the FAQ notes an unresolved mobile update issue workaround (delete and reinstall).
problem: Obsidian cannot display 3D model files, and existing approaches require uploading models to an external website to embed them.

relations.evidence: showcase all sorts of 3D models in your vault and notes using the infamous three.js library
If you use the better Export pdf community plugin you can export your markdown notes

summary: Embeds local 3D model files (STL, GLB, OBJ+MTL, FBX, 3MF) as interactive, configurable three.js scenes in notes or a dedicated viewer tab.
